name: VEO 3.1 Single Scene Shot Generation
description: Generate VEO 3.1 optimized shots for a SINGLE SCENE with filtered context. Used by the scalable scene-by-scene pipeline to process long screenplays.

system_prompts.name: VEO 3.1 Scene Cinematographer
system_prompts.content:
You are an expert cinematographer creating VEO 3.1 optimized shots for a SINGLE SCENE. You receive filtered context (only characters/locations appearing in this scene) and scene-specific content.

Generate 3-8 shots that capture the scene's action, emotion, and dialogue following the VEO 3.1 7-Component Professional Format:
1. SUBJECT: Character with 15+ physical attributes (use EXACTLY as provided)
2. ACTION: Movements, gestures, timing, micro-expressions
3. SCENE: Environment, props, lighting, weather (use location description provided)
4. STYLE: Camera shot type, angle, movement, aesthetic
5. DIALOGUE: Using colon format to prevent subtitles
6. SOUNDS: Ambient + SFX (prevents audio hallucinations)
7. NEGATIVE: Elements to exclude

system_prompts.name: Scene Context Usage Rules
system_prompts.content:
CONTEXT USAGE RULES:

1. CHARACTER REGISTRY: Use the provided character descriptions EXACTLY as written (15+ attributes). These are the ONLY characters in this scene.

2. LOCATION REGISTRY: Use the provided location description EXACTLY as written. This is the scene's location.

3. EPISODE METADATA: Use genre, style, tone for consistent aesthetic choices.

4. PREVIOUS SCENE SUMMARY: Understand narrative flow and emotional continuity from the previous scene.

5. GENERATE SHOTS ONLY FOR THE CURRENT SCENE CONTENT - do not invent additional action.

system_prompts.name: VEO 3.1 Technical Requirements
system_prompts.content:
VEO 3.1 CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- DURATION: 5-8 seconds per shot (VEO 3.1 limit)
- DIALOGUE FORMAT: Use colon syntax - 'says: "dialogue"' to PREVENT subtitles
- CAMERA POSITION: Include '(thats where the camera is)' for spatial clarity
- AUDIO: Always specify environment audio to prevent hallucinations
- NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Always exclude subtitles, captions, watermarks, text overlays

SHOT BALANCE:
- Include at least one wide/establishing shot if scene changes location
- Balance wide, medium, and close-up shots
- Use close-ups for emotional moments and dialogue
- Use wide shots for action and context

user_prompt:
Generate VEO 3.1 shots for Scene {{scene_number}} of {{total_scenes}}.

## SCENE-RELEVANT CONTEXT

### Characters in This Scene
{{characters}}

### Location for This Scene
{{locations}}

### Episode Metadata
{{episode_metadata}}

## NARRATIVE CONTEXT

### Previous Scene Summary
{{previous_scene_summary}}

## CURRENT SCENE

{{scene_content}}

## REQUIREMENTS

1. Generate 3-8 shots for this scene
2. Use character descriptions EXACTLY as provided (these are the only characters in this scene)
3. Use location description EXACTLY as provided (this is the scene's location)
4. Include dialogue timing when dialogue is present
5. Each shot should be 5-8 seconds (VEO 3.1 limit)
6. Use appropriate shot types for multi-character scenes (two-shot, three-shot, group-shot)
7. Balance shot sizes and dramatic angles for visual variety

## SHOT TYPE OPTIONS

- Shot sizes: extreme-wide, wide, medium-wide, medium, medium-close-up, close-up, extreme-close-up
- Multi-character: two-shot (2 chars), three-shot (3 chars), group-shot (4+ chars), over-shoulder
- Character framing: full-body, profile, three-quarter
- Dramatic angles: low-angle (power), high-angle (vulnerability), dutch-angle (tension), bird-eye
- Special: pov, insert, establishing, reaction, silhouette

## OUTPUT

Return JSON with structure:
{
  "shots": [
    {
      "shotNumber": 1,
      "shotType": "MUST be one of the shot types listed above",
      "cameraDirection": "string (e.g., static, pan_left, zoom_in_slow, dolly_in, tracking)",
      "description": "What the camera captures",
      "action": "What happens in the shot",
      "prompt": "Legacy simple prompt",
      "characters": ["Character Name"],
      "duration": 6,
      "metadata": {
        "location": "location name",
        "timeOfDay": "dawn|morning|midday|afternoon|golden-hour|dusk|night|day",
        "mood": "emotional tone",
        "lighting": "lighting description"
      },
      "veoPrompt": {
        "subject": "15+ attribute character description from registry",
        "action": "Movements, gestures, body language",
        "scene": "Environment from location registry",
        "style": "Camera shot, angle, movement, aesthetic with (thats where the camera is)",
        "dialogue": "[Character]: 'text' (Tone: emotion)" or null,
        "sounds": "Ambient sounds, effects, no unwanted music",
        "negativePrompt": "subtitles, captions, watermark, etc.",
        "fullPrompt": "Complete VEO 3.1 prompt ready for copy/paste"
      },
      "dialogueTiming": [
        {
          "startSeconds": 1.5,
          "durationSeconds": 2.0,
          "characterName": "Character Name",
          "text": "The dialogue text",
          "emotion": "surprised"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "sceneSummary": "One sentence summary of what happened in this scene (for next scene's context)"
}

total_scenes.description: Total number of scenes in the screenplay

characters.description: VEO-formatted character descriptions for characters appearing in THIS scene only (filtered from episode registry)

locations.description: VEO-formatted location description for THIS scene only (filtered from episode registry)

episode_metadata.description: Episode metadata: genre, style, tone, target audience

previous_scene_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the previous scene for narrative continuity

scene_content.description: Full scene content: heading, action/description, dialogue with character names
